versions.changelog:
- Migrated documentation and default settings from GDPR (EU) to CCPA/CPRA (California) context.
- Updated all descriptions, detection examples, and legal references to reflect CCPA/CPRA scope and terminology.
- Expanded/adjusted detection targets: now focused on US/California identifiers (SSN, CA driver's license, etc.) and CPRA-defined sensitive personal information.
- No functionality changes; the detection engine, risk grading, and overall workflow remain the same.
- Removed file: skill-card.md (no longer shipped with this version).

ccpa-guard v1.0.0

- Initial release of a local runtime guardrail for AI applications processing EU personal data, focusing on GDPR compliance.
- Provides real-time detection, masking, or blocking of structured personal data (e.g., IBAN, UK NI, EU phone, credit cards) and special category data under GDPR.
- Three operation modes: detect (report only), mask (mask and allow), block (high-risk data is blocked).
- Outputs structured JSON risk assessments for agent integration.
- Fully local, with no network requests or dynamic execution; depends only on the Python standard library.
